label: Sleeping Beauty experiment prior and retained-slot selection
definition: Protocol supplies a rational experiment prior 0<p<1 and a positive natural number k of Tails awakenings, with one Heads awakening. Experiment selection retains each experiment once, giving Heads marginal p. Retained-slot selection first chooses an experiment with that prior, independently chooses one of k potential slots uniformly, and conditions on the slot containing an actual awakening; Heads retention likelihood is 1/k, Tails retention likelihood is 1. slotHeads is the resulting ratio (p/k)/(p/k+1-p). Awakening-weighted mass is p/[p+k(1-p)]. The certificate proves equality, positive normalization and strict reduction from p exactly when k>1. These are externally specified protocols, not an epistemic rule for Beauty.
